entries.note: The order's details reached ParcelABC, the first row of an order.
The courier has the shipment's details before it collects the parcel. It can alternate with More information required.
The page explains that the shipment's information is incomplete: the parcel waits for the sender to complete it.
The courier collected the parcel from the sender.
ParcelABC's label for most of the courier's scans, whose own wording the row's comment gives.
A scan at one of the courier's facilities, its collection scan included.
A delivery attempt that did not deliver, a refusal included.
A claim opened for the shipment, such as for a parcel the courier cannot deliver.
The parcel went back to the sender.
The parcel was delivered.
ParcelABC refunded the order, which then goes no further. The comment can say Full refund.
The page's list of statuses explains that the address did not match ParcelABC's records.
The page's list of statuses explains that the courier could not deliver to an incorrect or incomplete address.
The parcel was damaged, from the page's list of statuses.
The courier's delivery round, from the page's list of statuses.
The parcel reached the destination country, from the page's list of statuses.
The parcel was lost, from the page's list of statuses.
The page's list of statuses explains that the shipment has no status yet. It moves nothing.
A delay ParcelABC is resolving, as the page's list of statuses explains.
The order was cancelled, from the page's list of statuses.
Part of the shipment is delivered and the rest is still on its way, so the shipment is not complete.
The recipient refused the shipment, from the page's list of statuses.
The courier's collection from the sender moved to another time. It moves nothing.
The page's list of statuses explains that the order moved to another courier. It moves nothing.
A refund request sent to ParcelABC's administration. It moves nothing.
ParcelABC's system closed the order. It moves nothing.
A note on the order. It moves nothing.
Part of the price refunded. It moves nothing.
